events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 years since his death
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, legendary rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, dying six days later. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost Tupac Shakur. His impact on music and culture is still felt today. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, guitar icon Jimi Hendrix passed away in London. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix, a true pioneer, left us on this day in 1970. His guitar playing changed everything. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous of all time.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: The original iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped 25 years ago? It changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, what's your all-time favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Double Album Delight
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. So much music, so many different sounds. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles Release 'Rubber Soul' (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles released their seminal album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly marked a shift in their sound. A masterpiece, wouldn't you agree?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's death
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic death of music icon John Lennon. He would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost a visionary. John Lennon's music and message of peace live on.
